answer: Operator Liability Escrow. Each agent identity must route its first transactions through a named operator account that posts a per-identity escrow, an inlet that holds real collateral. If any identity tied to that operator is flagged for coordinated fake activity, the escrow is seized and the operator's other identities face a violet freeze on payouts until review clears. This costs an attacker one escrow per wallet, so mass registration becomes linear in real money. An oasis of legitimate operators stays unaffected.
